content: In the translated passage, the ALM calculation attributed to Ibn Barrajān runs: ALM = 71 in jummal-i kabīr, multiplied by biḍʿ (eight) gives 568; in jummal-i ṣaghīr ALM = 8, plus eight is 16, minus one is 15, added to 568 gives 583/1187, the year Muslims took Jerusalem from the Franks. MK's footnote (pdf p.330) notes this numerological rationale is Ibn ʿArabī's, not in Ibn Barrajān's own text.
